paper_statement_to_use: On one 144-frame sequence the frozen Full result assigns the annotated actor and active foot at all 13 receive/kick events.
evidence: paper_eval/summary.csv full correct_foot_association_rate=1.0; event_chain_comparison.csv full actor and foot rates = 1
do_not_say: That events were discovered by the optimizer

paper_statement_to_use: All 6 annotated kick-to-receive transfers are role-consistent (sender robot and foot then receiver robot and foot; predicted kick before predicted receive).
do_not_say: That this is a physical task-success rate

paper_statement_to_use: Centre-gated chain consistency at a predefined 0.05 m surface threshold is 6/6 for Full. Mesh-gated consistency at 0.05 m is 3/6 because the foot mesh enters the ball sphere.
do_not_say: That a smaller toe-centre distance is always better

paper_statement_to_use: Event-conditioned IK with the ball held fixed does not change actor limb or chain assignment. It reduces kick-foot velocity RMSE from about 0.66 to 0.20 m/s and roughly doubles jerk.
evidence: event_coordination_extension/fixed_ball_ablation.csv and evaluation_report.md frozen_reference event_off vs event_on
do_not_say: That event IK is a coordination gain

paper_statement_to_use: An independent per-robot solver that also sees the same frozen ball matches 13/13 and 6/6 and improves surface deviation versus Full. Soccer Full is two separable IK problems plus post-IK ball synthesis.
do_not_say: That Soccer uses EXT-JC or a joint two-robot loss

paper_statement_to_use: Chain consistency on Full follows from the supplied annotation the lane schedule and generating the ball from the annotated feet. It is not evidence of coupled optimization.
evidence: dependency_audit.md; separability_probe.json deltas of 0 on every robot-A stage
do_not_say: That the method jointly optimizes both robots and the ball

paper_statement_to_use: The object path is prescribed and event/scene-conditioned. It is not the result of foot-ball contact physics.
do_not_say: Physical football dynamics or contact forces

paper_statement_to_use: Human motion is two independent GVHMR pseudo-labels placed in one scene. It is not mocap and not a metric two-person reconstruction.
Timing error on Full is 0.17 frames (receive) and 0.57 frames (kick) under a fixed plus-or-minus-4-frame earliest-minimum rule.
do_not_say: Sub-frame contact timing from a force sensor

paper_statement_to_use: Results are one sequence. The 13 events are dependent samples. No cross-sequence standard deviation.
